findings.citation: 23. ... every Fleet action to work inside its tab as it does today ... / 21. ... the chosen tab kept when I pick another Client or Contract ... / Solution, Carriers: "After a mutation: router.refresh(), as today."
findings.note: Confirms the race in the 2026-10-16 Decisions-taken entry. selectTab/select call history.replaceState(null, ...). Next 16.3.5 wraps replaceState and dispatches a restore action (app-router.js:268-279); dispatchAction discards any running action when a restore arrives (app-router-instance.js:147-161), re-running only server actions (84-88); restoreReducer reuses the pre-refresh tree. A correction's router.refresh() is lost when the user switches tab or picks a Client before it returns; tables keep old values (controlled 'Installed in' snaps back) until reload. Same in the Manager's selectTab (contracts-view.tsx:923-930) and Carriers' select. Regression vs main. e2e fix 6f1f3af only waits it out.

findings.citation: 13. ... with an archived Carrier staying selected, moved to the bottom and marked "Archived" ... / Solution: "Archiving a Carrier keeps it selected"
findings.note: carrierId starts as initialCarrierId ?? "" and selection is carriers.find(id) ?? carriers[0]; without ?carrier= archiving (or renaming) the first Carrier makes the selection jump to another. Start from the resolved row's real id.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md (Frontend 14): `params`/`searchParams` are typed and parsed once at the top of the route or page; do not re-parse them further down the tree.
findings.note: ?tab= reaches the views as an unvalidated string and is parsed into FleetTabId by fleetTabFromParam down the tree; call it in each page (fleet-tabs-card.tsx is server-importable) and pass a FleetTabId.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md Layout (line 166): sideways table scroll is for narrow viewports; Side list: the column exists only at xl so the detail keeps enough width
findings.note: At 1440px desktop (goldens agent-fleet-desktop-*, manager-contracts-desktop-*) the Fleet SIM Cards table no longer fits its card: the Installed in select is clipped at the card edge, the Change status column (Retire/Reactivate) is reachable only by sideways scroll, and the 'Monthly fee' header wraps. On main every column fit. The spec's assumption that 736px is enough for the 720px minimum does not hold, because the table's real width is larger.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md Contract Switcher: collapses to a static chip with one option
findings.note: The 'Agent' select always renders, even with a single Contract: an interactive control with one option. NOTE: the human explicitly chose 'shown even when there is only one Agent' (spec, confirmed 2026-10-15) — keep it. human: the Agent dropdown shows even with one Agent, confirmed 2026-10-15 (answer 'j. yes'); epic Intent point 5.1.
The Client heading uses text-lg (18px), off the type hierarchy; the Carrier detail heading is text-sm (carriers-view.tsx:250), so the two detail areas disagree.
The Carrier became the h2 but offer-list headings stay h4, so h3 is skipped.
Tabs section says only the Fleet views use tabs (Manager Contracts does too); the Do line at 252 lists side lists only on Client Invoices and Fleet.

findings.note: With the 60-char plan the SIM table is 1250px vs 1154px with a short plan (name cut at 192px correctly), and the table scrolls inside its 894px overflow-x-auto wrapper at 1440. Same root as the design audit's table-fit finding. Evidence: evidence/step-3-run.json.
